description: This Scala source file defines configuration parameters for Python-related settings in Apache Spark, including worker reuse, timeouts, modules, socket options, and fault handling.

classes.name: Python
classes.description: Object containing Spark configuration parameters related to Python execution environment.

methods.name: PYTHON_WORKER_REUSE
methods.description: Configuration for reusing Python workers, default true.

methods.name: PYTHON_TASK_KILL_TIMEOUT
methods.description: Timeout for killing Python tasks, default 2 seconds.

methods.name: PYTHON_USE_DAEMON
methods.description: Flag to use Python daemon, default true.

methods.name: PYTHON_LOG_INFO
methods.description: Flag for detailed Python worker logs, default false.

methods.name: PYSPARK_EXECUTOR_MEMORY
methods.description: Optional memory setting for PySpark executor.

methods.name: PYTHON_AUTH_SOCKET_TIMEOUT
methods.description: Socket timeout for Python authentication, default 15 seconds.

methods.name: PYTHON_WORKER_FAULTHANLDER_ENABLED
methods.description: Enable faulthandler in Python workers, default false.

methods.name: PYTHON_UNIX_DOMAIN_SOCKET_ENABLED
methods.description: Enable Unix domain socket for Python driver, default based on environment variable.

methods.name: PYTHON_UNIX_DOMAIN_SOCKET_DIR
methods.description: Directory for Unix domain socket files, optional with path length check.

methods.name: PYTHON_WORKER_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
methods.description: Idle timeout in seconds for Python workers, default 0 (no timeout).

methods.name: PYTHON_WORKER_KILL_ON_IDLE_TIMEOUT
methods.description: Flag to kill Python worker on idle timeout, default false.

methods.name: PYTHON_WORKER_TRACEBACK_DUMP_INTERVAL_SECONDS
methods.description: Interval for dumping Python worker tracebacks, default 0 (disabled).

methods.name: PYTHON_FACTORY_IDLE_WORKER_MAX_POOL_SIZE
methods.description: Max idle Python workers to keep, optional positive integer.

methods.name: PYTHON_DAEMON_KILL_WORKER_ON_FLUSH_FAILURE
methods.description: Kill Python daemon worker on flush failure, default true.

search-terms: Python daemon kill on flush failure
